formats.name: template_body_header_footer
formats.notes: Body 1024 chars, text header 60 (title_max_chars), footer 60, up to 10 buttons, button label 25, URL up to 2000 chars. Template name up to 512.

formats.name: image
formats.notes: JPEG or PNG, 8-bit RGB or RGBA.

formats.name: video
formats.notes: MP4 or 3GP, H.264 video, AAC audio (single or no audio stream).

formats.name: audio
formats.notes: AAC, AMR, MP3, M4A, OGG (OPUS, mono).

formats.name: sticker_static
formats.notes: WebP, 100 KB static; animated stickers 500 KB.

formats.name: broadcast_list_business_app
formats.notes: 256 contacts per list; recipients must have your number saved; not on desktop or web.

formats.name: channel_update
formats.notes: Text, image, video, sticker, link, audio, poll. One-way; followers react or vote only. Insights cover last 30 days.

formats.name: cloud_api_group
formats.notes: Up to 8 participants per group and 10,000 groups per number; Official Business Account required.
